items.title: Craftable Imposters
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Are there impostors lurking among us? Do you know who to trust? Time to craft your own impostors and be sure. Find detailed recipes of impostors, collect the needed materials, and make your own impostors. 

Fun fact — these impostors are interactive and animated. Give them props and see what they do or fight them to flush out the real imposter.
4 sus skins
1 free skin

items.title: Items Alive!
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Grab this random and funny 'Items Alive' skin pack!
Dress as an item and make your friends laugh with varied expressions!

+ 12 Items Alive skins!
+ 2 free skins!
+ Includes health potion, emerald, and redstone skins!

items.title: Pirates
items.creator: Shapescape
items.description:
Be a pirate with one of these pirate-themed skins! Board your friends ships in style and show them who's the coolest pirate! 

+ 6 skins!
+ Perfect for role-play
+ Skins for ruling over the Seven Seas!

items.title: Skyblock Vanilla
items.creator: Cynosia
items.description:
Play Skyblock Vanilla! Create the biggest island with all of your friends! Use the shop to get coins and buy new items for your island to get even bigger! See how far you will come starting from only a small island in the air!

- Five skins
- Custom cobblestone generator
- Usable shop
- Made by Artifact Studios

items.title: TNT EXPANSION PACK
items.creator: SNDBX
items.description:
What could go wrong with some modded TNT? We’ve got everything you need. Start a thunderstorm with Lightning TNT, or make one massive hole with the Big Bertha. We've got anything you need, hotshot.

+ 35 Craftable, modded TNT
+ Shooter mech
+ Bigger blast, better explosions, ultimate destruction
+ Explosion test facility
